'''Ana Bela Cruzeiro''' (born 1957){{r|born}} is a Portuguese and Swiss mathematician whose research concerns [[stochastic analysis]] and the [[Malliavin calculus]], as well as the [[differential equation]]s used to model [[fluid dynamics]] and [[quantum mechanics]]. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[Instituto Superior Técnico]], part of the [[University of Lisbon]].{{r|cv}}

==Education and career==
After earning a master's degree in mathematics at the University of Lisbon in 1980, Cruzeiro studied mathematics at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in Paris, earning a [[diplôme d'études approfondies]] in 1982, a [[doctorat de troisième cycle]] in 1983, and a [[doctorat d'état]] in 1985.{{r|cv}} Her 1985 doctoral dissertation, ''Equations différentielles ordinaires et équations différentielles stochastiques sur l'espace de Wiener'', was supervised by [[Paul Malliavin]].{{r|mg}} She also earned a [[habilitation]] (agregação) at the University of Lisbon in 1991.{{r|cv}}

She has been on the faculty of the University of Lisbon since 1986, and became a full professor in Instituto Superior Técnico in 2002.{{r|cv}}

==Recognition==
Cruzeiro is a corresponding member of the [[Lisbon Academy of Sciences]], elected in 2020.{{r|las}}
